summary: Creates an external CHOP input connector on the parent component and passes incoming channels into the component network.
key_concepts: Each In CHOP inside a component adds one CHOP input connector to that parent component.
It passes channels connected to the parent component input into the internal component network.
Label controls the connector hover label shown on the parent COMP.
Num Channels validates incoming channel count and can intentionally raise an error on mismatch.
Names filters incoming channels when Num Channels is used, but renames channels when Num Channels is not used.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Connector label shown on the parent COMP

key_params.name: numchannels
key_params.note: Expected channel count; can error if mismatched

common_gotchas: Each In CHOP inside a component adds one input connector to the parent component.
Num Channels can intentionally error when incoming channel counts are wrong.
When used with Num Channels, Names filters to matching channels and ignores the rest.
When used without Num Channels, Names acts as a channel rename pattern.
Use In CHOP for component interfaces rather than direct relative references when building reusable COMPs.
